Add measured cost-hint line to suite-cost-hints.txt

approaches_tried.approach: Fixture (d) with status not_started for both absent-scope candidates
approaches_tried.reason: orchestrate-batch-admit.sh unconditionally exempts a research/plan-routed absent-scope candidate from the blocking in_batch branch (same D-phase rationale as self-modification); not_started routes to research by default, so both admitted and the fixture never exercised the intended branch. Fixed by using status=planned (routes to implement group).
jq -r on an array value prints multi-line, so the string comparison against the compact literal "[10]" never matched even though the write succeeded. Fixed by using jq -c (compact) instead.
